item.title: Sidekick 0.3.0
item.description: New Transcribe tool: drop audio or video files (like lectures) and get a timestamped transcript on-device, with Whisper or Apple's engine. Copy or export as .txt, keep past transcripts, optional cleanup, and a queue that keeps working with the window closed. Dictation switches to Apple's engine while a Whisper transcription runs.

item.title: Sidekick 0.2.0
item.description: Two new tools. Window Manager: snap windows to halves, quarters, thirds and more with ⌃⌥ shortcuts, or drag a window to a screen edge. Volume Mixer: set each app's volume from a speaker icon in the menu bar, and Sidekick remembers every app's level. Turn them on from Sidekick's Home page.

item.title: Sidekick 0.1.0
item.description: First release: Dictation (formerly Parrot) — hold Fn, speak, and clean text appears where you're typing. Your Parrot history imports automatically.
